passage.label: Recite name Lord created; created man clinging substance; Recite Lord most Generous; taught pen; taught man knew not

mainSubject.label: The first revelation commanding recitation in the name of the Lord who created man from a clinging substance; He is the Most Generous who taught by the pen and taught man what he did not know

Man created from a clinging substance

commandsAndProhibitions.description: Recite in the name of your Lord who created.
Recite, and your Lord is the Most Generous.

relationships.label: Creation from alaq paired with teaching by qalam as dual divine gifts

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the teaching-by-the-pen declaration (5) before the transgression diagnosis opens (6); P2 ends with the divine-sight question (14) before the forelock-dragging threat begins (15); P3 runs through the lying forelock, the associate-challenge, the Hell-angels summons and the closing prostration command (15-19).
